integrity_notes: Exact integer checks and a self-contained argument accompany the theorem; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact trace law is for all positive finite cyclic rings. The pairwise-independence and moment identities require n>=7. The Gaussian limit is an asymptotic statement for uniformly sampled attainable ring targets, not an orbitwise, bi-infinite or cryptographic guarantee. The earlier weighted collision automaton can implicitly compute finite distributions; absence of an equivalent published probabilistic theorem is not independently certified.
title: Pairwise-independent preimage-twin distances in a nonlinear binary cellular automaton
